title: Sorting homotopy for the module Cech projection
statement: For the same module Cech presentation, differential compatibility and local scalar compatibility as in [def-pc-ordered-cech-module-coordinates], let P be any cochain endomorphism of L=(f'_*D)^ext satisfying the finite signed projection formula of [lem-pc-ordered-cech-module-projection-lift]. Then the identity endomorphism of L is homotopic to P as a map of module-sheaf complexes. This statement has no endomorphism g and no hypothesis that ordered coordinates vanish.

proof.text: Obtain the first and second locally linear sorting families H and J from their separate module-sheaf boundary statements. In every nonnegative degree, evaluate their two nullHomotopicMap boundaries on sections and full tuple coordinates. Additivity of the coordinate maps gives (c(s)-kappa(c(s)))+(kappa(c(s))-c(Ps))=c(s)-c(Ps). Joint injectivity of the evaluated product projections, e and extendXIso proves that the sum of the two boundary maps equals identity minus P. In a negative degree use the zero object of the extended complex. Add the two canonical null homotopies and use Homotopy.equivSubZero to conclude.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01FM, addition of the two sorting boundaries
proof_origin.note: Compiled reduction into the two distinct module-sheaf sorting boundaries; coordinate extensionality and addition of the null homotopies are proved in Lean.

mathlib_searches.results: Only Dold-Kan summand and map lemmas were returned. They concern simplicial normalization, not the local module action or ordered Cech coordinates.
Generic Homotopy.compLeft composes an existing homotopy with a cochain map; it does not construct the signed projection or its locally linear homotopy.

theorem orderedCech_module_projection_homotopy {X' T' : Scheme.{u}} (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (M : X'.Modules) {r : ℕ} (W₀ : ULift.{u} (Fin r) → X'.Opens)
    (D : CochainComplex X'.Modules ℕ)
    (e : ∀ p : ℕ, (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).obj
          (D.X p).val ≅
        ((cechComplexFunctor W₀).obj
          ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
            (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
              M.presheafModuleCat)).X p)
    (hd : ∀ p : ℕ,
        (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map
            (D.d p (p + 1)).val ≫ (e (p + 1)).hom =
          (e p).hom ≫ ((cechComplexFunctor W₀).obj
            ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
              M.presheafModuleCat)).d p (p + 1))
    (hlinear : ∀ (p : ℕ) (y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r)) (B : X'.Opens),
        let c : Γ(D.X p, B) → Γ(M, (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)) ⨯ B) :=
          fun s ↦ ((e p).hom ≫ Pi.π (fun y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦
            ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
                M.presheafModuleCat).obj
                (op (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)))) y).app (op B) s
        ∀ (a : Γ(X', B)) (s : Γ(D.X p, B)),
          c (a • s) = X'.presheaf.map (prod.snd :
            (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)) ⨯ B ⟶ B).op a • c s)
    (P : ((((Modules.pushforward f').mapHomologicalComplex _).obj D).extend
      ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) ⟶
      ((((Modules.pushforward f').mapHomologicalComplex _).obj D).extend
      ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))
    (hP : IsOrderedCechModuleProjection f' M W₀ D e P) :
    Nonempty (Homotopy (𝟙 _) P)
